citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 2:15 pm on
7/16/2026. The inspectors spoke to individuals in the front office who said that the two people who are familiar with USDA
inspections are unavailable on this particular day. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for
inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in
enforcement action.
End Section
